run_generate_modify_templates: run the st_templates module to generate N templated modify command samples and write them to a target directory
build_lf_dialogue_action: build a HUMAN_GIVE_COMMAND dialogue action dict from a reference object and modify dictionary
replace_with_span_identifiers: replace block and object identifiers in a dict with span indices based on split text tokens
generate_thicken_scale_rigidmotion_repla: generate a random modify template for thickening, scaling, rigid motion, replacing, or filling a target object
get_target_object_block_location: get a random target object, block, or location dict and text for use in modify template generation
